subject: Sunward activation — prioritization request for tenant audit & export hooks
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@sunward.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@sunward.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sunward activation — prioritization request for tenant audit & export hooks

Team — looping you in on an ask from Sunward (they're our fastest-moving mid‑enterprise close this quarter). Procurement has a final SOW but legal is flagging two gating requirements before they will sign:

1) Tenant-level audit exports (daily full exports and near-real-time audit stream for admin events)
2) Per-tenant retention settings and an exportable retention-reporting artifact for audits

Attached is the workbook Sarah sent that summarizes the compliance asks. High level: they want a product commitment that we can deliver a minimal export API and a CSV-based audit dump within a 6‑week window, otherwise they will push the start date to next quarter. This is explicitly blocking the signed PO.

Ask: can Product/Eng scope a minimal implementation that:
- provides an /admin/audit-export endpoint (CSV/JSON) with last-90-day data;
- supports per-tenant retention flags in the control plane (initial UI optional — API-only OK);
- a short-term telemetry hook (webhook) for admin events if real-time streaming is complex.

Ben — can you weigh in on feasibility and a minimal ship ETA? Priyom — can we define acceptance criteria and a canary plan (I know we have INF-4021 on the backlog but we need a compressed timeline). Monica — will coordinate Sunward expectations and procurement timeline (they want contract executed by 6/23).

Neha
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Sunward_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf), sunward-audit-requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sunward activation — prioritization request for tenant audit & export hooks

Thanks — quick read through the workbook. Signal: doable as a scoped, API-first deliverable. Notes below on tradeoffs and a proposed minimal plan.

Tradeoffs/risks:
- Full fidelity event stream (Kafka/CloudPubSub) is a larger effort; a webhook fanout or S3-delivered CSV is much faster.
- Retention flags require metadata changes and a retention-cleaner job; we can gate initial rollout to a single region/customer to limit blast radius.

Proposed minimal ship (6 weeks target):
- Week 1: Design + acceptance criteria (INF-4021 -> split into INF-4021A/INF-4021B)
- Week 2–3: Implement audit-export endpoint (paginate, CSV and JSON) + simple retention metadata schema
- Week 4: Implement retention cleaner job (configurable, dry-run mode) + admin API to toggle per-tenant policies
- Week 5: Hook up webhook for admin events (configurable endpoint per tenant)
- Week 6: Canary with Sunward + runbook + docs + billing tag (to capture any cost uplift)

Dependencies: infra time to enable S3 export buckets and short-term credentials for Sunward; support to scope a canary path. I'll mark INF-4021A as P0 and draft tickets. Priyom — can you own acceptance criteria and the canary rollback policy?

Ben
Group Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@sunward.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@sunward.com>, procurement@sunward.com
Date: Mon, 13 May 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sunward activation — prioritization request for tenant audit & export hooks

Neha — thanks for speeding this along. To be explicit: our security team requires a written commitment that the feature will be available for our tenant prior to contract start. We need:

- A signed statement of scope tied to delivery ETA (we can accept a staged delivery: export API + retention controls first, real‑time streaming later)
- An acceptance test we can run to validate the export contains admin events and login/audit trails

Procurement has pushed back on start dates without that commitment; the SOW is otherwise agreed. If Redwood can provide a delivery commitment for the minimal ship by 6/23, procurement will proceed to sign and release the PO.

Thanks — Sarah
Director, IT Compliance | Sunward Financial Services
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 May 2028 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sunward activation — prioritization request for tenant audit & export hooks

Agree with Ben's plan. I've sketched acceptance criteria and a canary runbook (short bullets below) and created INF-4021A/B in Jira. Linking: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4021

Acceptance criteria (minimal ship):
- /admin/audit-export?tenant_id=SUNWARD returns CSV/JSON with events for last 90 days; correct columns (timestamp, user_id, action, resource, ip)
- Admin API to set retention_days per tenant; retention job honors setting in dry-run and live modes
- Sunward can configure a webhook endpoint and receive admin event POSTs for a 72-hr canary window
- Runbook includes rollback: disable webhook, revert retention flag, revoke S3 credentials

Canary notes:
- Start with a single tenant in us-west-2; run for 72 hours with Sunward's security engineer validating artifacts
- Capture telemetry (latency, export job duration, token usage) and an incident playbook

I'll coordinate with Eng to reserve a sprint slot. Ben — can you confirm resource ETA (1 FE, 1 BE, 0.5 SRE) and I'll formalize schedule for Neha to share with Sunward procurement.

Priyom
Senior Product Engineer | Redwood Inference
